buildCommand: npx --yes pnpm@9.12.0 --filter @bufet/shared build && npx --yes pnpm@9.12.0 --filter @bufet/dashboard build:web && sourceDist=$(find . -type f -path '*/dist/index.html' -print -quit | sed 's#/index.html##') && if [ "$sourceDist" != "dist" ] && [ "$sourceDist" != "./dist" ]; then rm -rf dist && cp -R "$sourceDist" dist; fi
